types.x: procedure (EXTERNAL); the code after x is its result type

templates.note: A type starting with T or R takes the routine’s precision (its `p`, else the first letter of its name when that is s, d, c or z): T is its own type, R the real type of the same precision.

tags.wsq: documents a workspace query: called with LWORK = -1 (or LIWORK, LRWORK), it only returns the optimal workspace size in WORK(1)
tags.ld: has leading-dimension arguments; `ld` gives each one’s lower bound, such as max(1,n)
tags.info: returns INFO: 0 on success, -i when argument i had an illegal value, > 0 for a routine-specific failure

fields.p: precision letter for the T and R templates, when it is not the first letter of the name (icamax: c)
fields.g: precision family (the \ingroup; for deprecated routines, the name without its precision letter); its record in `groups` holds the defaults, and a key ending in c (ac, sc, …) is the default for the complex members (c, z)
fields.l: library (see libraries), when it is not lapack
fields.ld: lower bounds of the leading dimensions
fields.u: Netlib member-page anchor in the family’s group page
fields.v: Netlib member-page anchor in the file’s page, for routines without a group page
fields.U: Netlib member page, when it does not follow the rules
fields.f: source file, when it is not <name>.f
fields.n: family display name, when it is not the group id (gesv_mixed shows as gesv)
fields.title: family title from LAPACK’s DOCS/groups-usr.dox

netlib.rule: group and file are escaped as Doxygen does (_ → __, . → _8, so dgesv.f → dgesv_8f); dir is d{md5(page)[14]&0xf}/d{md5(page)[15]:02x} of the page name (group__{group} or the escaped file); the file page, from `f` or <name>.f, is the fallback when an anchor is missing or stale
